name: get_aml_report
label: Get AML report (poll)
description: Poll the status and result of an asynchronous AML report started with 'Start AML report'. Map the `rapport_id` value returned by 'Start AML report' into this module's Job ID field; returns status (pending/running/done/failed). When 'done' it includes the AML risk score (0-100), level (low/medium/high) and links to the stored report; when 'failed' it includes the error reason. Chain this after 'Start AML report' in a scenario (add a delay/repeater until status is done or failed).

parameters.name: report_id
parameters.label: Job ID (rapport_id)
parameters.help: The `rapport_id` returned by 'Start AML report'. ⚠️ Map the `rapport_id` field — NOT `report_id`. 'Start AML report' does not return a field called `report_id`; this module's own `report_id` output is the finished report, not the value to poll with.

validate.patternErrorMessage: Report ID must be a 32-character hex job id.
